title: Raymond Moody's psychomanteum and the underground oracle temples of ancient Greece

tellings.quote: I mean a modern example of it would be the psychoantium developed by Raymond Moody that was based on the discovery in ancient Greece of underground temples

plain: A researcher named Raymond Moody built a room he called the psychomanteum, said to be modelled on underground temples found in ancient Greece, where people went to consult oracles. Jeffrey Mishlove, a parapsychologist with a doctorate, offers it as a modern example of that ancient practice, which would mean an old Greek method for contacting other realms has been revived.
